description: This file defines the 'Table' class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, handling spreadsheet tables including properties such as name, range, style, filtering, and columns, along with methods for setting and validating these properties.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Represents a spreadsheet table with properties like name, range, style, columns, filters and methods for manipulation.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the table.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the table, with validation against invalid or duplicate names.

methods.name: getShowHeaderRow
methods.description: Returns whether the header row is shown.

methods.name: setShowHeaderRow
methods.description: Enables or disables the header row display.

methods.name: getShowTotalsRow
methods.description: Returns whether the totals row is shown.

methods.name: setShowTotalsRow
methods.description: Enables or disables the totals row display.

methods.name: getAllowFilter
methods.description: Returns whether filtering is allowed on the table.

methods.name: setAllowFilter
methods.description: Enables or disables autofiltering for the table.

methods.name: getRange
methods.description: Returns the cell range of the table.

methods.name: setRange
methods.description: Sets the cell range of the table, validating range correctness.

methods.name: setRangeToMaxRow
methods.description: Adjusts the range to extend to the maximum row in the worksheet.

methods.name: getWorksheet
methods.description: Returns the worksheet associated with the table.

methods.name: setWorksheet
methods.description: Associates the table with a worksheet, checking for duplicate table names.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Returns all columns of the table.

methods.name: isColumnInRange
methods.description: Checks if a specified column is within the table range and returns its offset.

methods.name: getColumnOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset of a specified column within the table range.

methods.name: getColumn
methods.description: Retrieves a specific column object, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getColumnByOffset
methods.description: Returns a column object based on its offset.

methods.name: setColumn
methods.description: Sets or replaces a column in the table.

methods.name: clearColumn
methods.description: Removes a column from the table.

methods.name: shiftColumn
methods.description: Moves a column rule from one column to another.

methods.name: getStyle
methods.description: Returns the style object of the table.

methods.name: setStyle
methods.description: Sets the style object for the table.

methods.name: getAutoFilter
methods.description: Returns the AutoFilter object.

methods.name: setAutoFilter
methods.description: Sets the AutoFilter object.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Creates a deep clone of the table object.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the table range as string representation.
